subject: English
question_text: Fill in the gaps with suitable prepositions, articles and zero articles (a, an, the or x): 0.
stimulus: We live in (a) _____ age of science. We can see (b) _____ influence of science in all spheres of life. Science is (c) _____ constant companion (d) _____ our life. We have made the impossible things possible by means (e) _____ science. The modern civilization is a gift (f) _____ of science. At present, we can easily travel (g) _____ one place to another. (h) _____ ancient time, the journey was difficult. Travellers had to spend much time and money (i) _____ travelling. But science has made it easy (j) _____ the mankind.
guide_solution: (a) an (b) the (c) a (d) of (e) of (f) × (g) from (h) In (i) on/for (j) for
